title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This project serves as a platform to showcase my work, connect with professionals, and share my experiences while exploring React, animations, and UX/UI design principles. As my first website, it has been an invaluable learning experience that has enhanced my skills!

title: ML4UVA: Satellite-Based Carbon Sequestration Estimation
description: Developed a custom convolutional neural network (CNN) architecture using Keras to classify multi-spectral Landsat 8 satellite imagery. Achieved 89% validation accuracy in segmenting Virginia’s wetlands, contributing to climate-focused machine learning research.
